raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Bumps [flash-linear-attention](https://github.com/fla-org/flash-linear-attention) from 0.5.2 to 0.6.0.
Release notes

Sourced from flash-linear-attention's releases.

v0.6.0

What's Changed

  • [Docs] Add fla-ascend-performance agent skill for Ascend NPU profiling and optimization by @​sunyi0505 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1068
  • [Fix] Zero-init Ascend chunk_scaled_dot_kkt output and add solve_tril to CI by @​zheliuyu in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1070
  • [Perf] Refactor Ascend KDA WY backward: split dA finalize and precompute dw workspace by @​sunyi0505 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1074
  • [Perf] Rewrite Ascend chunk_delta_h fwd by @​OsirisDuan in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1055
  • [Fix] Gate the recomputed output in layer_norm_gated backward by @​truong-v in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1071
  • [Fix] Use the full token stride for DPLR safe-gate offsets by @​morluto in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1085
  • [Fix] Fix int32 overflow in pointer arithmetic across Triton kernels by @​zhiyuan1i in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1082
  • [Feature] Add Ascend NPU backend for KDA fused recurrent forward by @​sunyi0505 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1090
  • [Fix] Restore tuple-form legacy cache round trips by @​morluto in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1089
  • [Fix] Correct GRPO loss with old log probabilities by @​dongchany in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1076
  • [GDN] Enable FlashQLA forward dispatch on SM120 by @​Akrao9 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1094
  • [GDN] Fix invalid launch above 65535/HV sequences in the state kernels by @​schmidt-jake in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1077
  • [Fix] Fix invalid launch above 65535 blocks in decode-path kernels by @​zhiyuan1i in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1097
  • [GDN] Match SM120 exactly for FlashQLA dispatch by @​Akrao9 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1098
  • [Fix] Preserve explicit cu_seqlens with attention masks by @​morluto in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1088
  • [CI] Enforce PR checklist and add PR template by @​zhiyuan1i in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1101
  • [CI] Run Ascend A2 CI on NPU-related file changes by @​zheliuyu in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1091
  • [Perf] Optimize KDA NPU recompute_w_u_fwd kernel launch and fused u/w loop- #1081 by @​sunyi0505 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1099
  • [Fix] Hoist in-kernel triton.next_power_of_2 to host launchers by @​zhiyuan1i in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1108
  • [Fix] Mask out-of-bounds accesses in RWKV7 channel mixing kernels by @​truong-v in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1103
  • [KDA] Fix illegal memory access in SM100 backward autotuning by @​lbx154 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1109
  • [Fix] Handle chunk-boundary-straddling key tiles in DeltaFormer forward by @​truong-v in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1105
  • [Fix] Ascend NPU: guard against tl.dot left-operand clobber across triton_ascend kernels by @​sunyi0505 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1113
  • [Fix] Restructure Ascend chunk_gated_delta_rule_bwd_dhu to AICore task loop by @​sunyi0505 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1118
  • [Perf] Optimize Ascend causal_conv1d with 1D core-grid and constexpr DMA split by @​sunyi0505 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1126
  • [Rodimus] Fix TypeError from stale head_first argument in chunk path by @​swayambshah in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1124
  • [GDN] Allow passing pre-computed chunk_indices to chunk_gated_delta_rule by @​zhiyuan1i in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1132
  • [Perf] Optimize Ascend KDA intra backward with split kernels and 1D core-grid by @​sunyi0505 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1130
  • [Fix] Correct the final-state gradient for chunks shorter than W - 1 by @​truong-v in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1141
  • [Fix] Honor the real layouts of y and dy in compute_dh0_kernel by @​truong-v in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1139
  • [Fix] Mask the g load in fused_recurrent_kda_fwd_kernel by @​truong-v in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1135
  • [Fix] Correct Ascend causal_conv1d short-chunk cache backward by @​sunyi0505 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1146
  • [Fix] Use native reverse scans in scalar cumsum by @​piero2c in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1095
  • [Typo] Fix recurring spelling errors across docs and layers by @​morluto in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1100
  • [Fix] Reject invalid context-parallel token partitions by @​morluto in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1093
  • [Cleanup] Remove remaining head_first code paths by @​zhiyuan1i in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1148
  • [Fix] Use native reverse scans in Ascend scalar cumsum by @​zhiyuan1i in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1150
  • [Perf] Optimize Ascend KDA wy backward with 1D core-grid and T-contiguous loads by @​sunyi0505 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1149
  • [Ops] Rewrite NPU chunk_scaled_dot_kkt_fwd by @​OsirisDuan in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1023
  • [Model] Add Preconditioned Gated DeltaNet (PGDN) and KDA (PKDA) by @​ntumm120 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#950
  • [Perf] A Tilelang implementation of DPLR by @​sablin39 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1069
  • [Fix] Handle a partial last chunk in log-linear attention by @​truong-v in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1143
  • [Perf] Optimize Ascend GDN fwd_h with dynamic tiling, oneslab path, and precomputed gates by @​sunyi0505 in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1157
  • [Ops] Add triton-ascend backend for chunk_gla by @​zheliuyu in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1121
  • [KDA] Make A_log optional in lower bound gate for KDA by @​yzhangcs in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1107
  • [DPLR] Add exact tensor-core (I-L)^-1 inversion for safe gates, default chunk_size to 64 for tight lower_bound by @​zhiyuan1i in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1162
  • [Fix] Return an integer from ShortConvolution.state_size by @​taking-lying-flat in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1133
  • [Fix] Allow GVA in fused recurrent GDN2 by @​taking-lying-flat in fla-org/flash-linear-attention#1166

... (truncated)

Commits
  • 413ad2c [Fix] Disable DeltaFormer cache by default (#1565)
  • d97f9c6 [Fix] Use epsilon-protected L1 normalization in MomentumDeltaNet (#1564)
  • c92725e [Fix] Route cached MesaNet multi-token continuation (#1569)
  • a51b6c7 [Fix] Respect packed boundaries with attention masks (#1575)
  • 63ca420 [Fix] Isolate CyFA empty-sequence gradients (#1572)
  • d5703d6 [Fix] Preserve ATK state for empty sequences (#1573)
  • b4231a4 [Fix] Preserve sliding-window context for cached chunks (#1568)
  • e1f2358 [Fix] Preserve recurrent states for empty packed sequences (#1571)
  • c8465af [Fix] Match Mamba2 Triton convolution contracts (#1574)
  • 54f725e [Fix] Align cached attention mask with truncated KV (#1567)
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view

files.patch:
@@ -141,7 +141,7 @@ fsdp = [
     "torchaudio==2.11.0",
     "liger-kernel==0.8.4",
     "trl==0.27.0",
-    "flash-linear-attention==0.5.2",
+    "flash-linear-attention==0.6.0",
     # transformers NOT pinned here: verl-core carries it and the project-wide
     # override below settles the version (5.12.1). See override-dependencies.
 ]
@@ -170,7 +170,7 @@ megatron = [
     # Native MoE dispatcher, built against this extra's torch 2.13 / CUDA 13.0.
     "deep-ep==1.2.1",
     # Qwen3.5 Gated DeltaNet kernels; Bridge's dependencies are disabled below.
-    "flash-linear-attention==0.5.2",
+    "flash-linear-attention==0.6.0",
     # megatron.bridge.training.config imports megatron.energon at module level,
     # and bridge is installed deps-free, so it has to be listed here.
     "megatron-energon==7.4.1",
@@ -202,7 +202,7 @@ veomni = [
     "torchaudio==2.11.0",
     "liger-kernel==0.8.4",
     "trl==0.27.0",
-    "flash-linear-attention==0.5.2",
+    "flash-linear-attention==0.6.0",
     "veomni==0.1.12",
 ]
